# University of Northern British Columbia

> UNBC is a comprehensive research university in Prince George, BC, specializing in northern and indigenous-focused education with strong commitments to reconciliation, sustainability, and community engagement.

UNBC serves students across four faculties with undergraduate and graduate programs, supported by extensive campus services, research initiatives, and indigenous partnerships. The university emphasizes northern research, First Nations collaboration, and regional accessibility.

## Admissions & Programs

- [Apply to UNBC](https://www.unbc.ca/admissions/apply-now): Application portal for undergraduate and graduate programs at UNBC
- [Programs and Admissions](https://www.unbc.ca/programs-and-admissions): Gateway to undergraduate and graduate programs, admissions, and financial information
- [Programs](https://www.unbc.ca/programs-courses): Complete listing of UNBC programs across four faculties with course registration
- [Future Students Portal](https://www.unbc.ca/future-students): Prospective student portal with programs, admissions, and financial aid information

## Campus Services & Resources

- [Services Directory](https://www.unbc.ca/services): Directory of campus services including registrar, health, IT, and financial aid
- [Geoffrey R. Weller Library](https://www.unbc.ca/library): Library services including research support, borrowing, and institutional repository
- [Academic Calendar](https://www.unbc.ca/calendar): Official 2025-2026 academic calendar with semester dates and deadlines
- [Life at UNBC](https://www.unbc.ca/campus-life): Campus life resources including housing, student organizations, and athletics
- [Charles Jago Northern Sport Centre](https://www.unbc.ca/northern-sport-centre): Recreation facility with fitness, sports programs, and community wellness activities

## Research & Innovation

- [Office of Research and Innovation](https://www.unbc.ca/office-research-and-innovation): Research office overseeing student research, funding awards, and STEM initiatives
- [Our Stories](https://www.unbc.ca/our-stories): Student research and success stories highlighting indigenous studies and northern research

## Indigenous Initiatives & Reconciliation

- [Indigenous Connections](https://www.unbc.ca/indigenous-connections): Indigenous initiatives, First Nations Centre, and reconciliation programs at UNBC

## About UNBC

- [University Homepage](https://www.unbc.ca): UNBC homepage showcasing admissions, research, and indigenous reconciliation initiatives
- [About the University](https://www.unbc.ca/about-unbc): Overview of UNBC mission, vision, values, campuses, and sustainability commitment

## Community & Support

- [Contact UNBC](https://www.unbc.ca/about-unbc/contact): Contact information for UNBC offices, regional campuses, and Prince George locations
- [Career Opportunities](https://www.unbc.ca/career-opportunities): Job postings for faculty, staff, and student employment with diversity commitment
- [UNBC Events](https://www.unbc.ca/events): Campus events calendar featuring seminars, workshops, and thesis defences
